bundles.name: Sovereign Coder
bundles.short: Privacy-first daily coding loop. Local-only by default. 6-step workflow: census -> intake -> plan -> build -> verify -> ship.
bundles.when_to_use: You are writing or modifying code. You want the sovereign agent to plan first, emit a unified diff, run veritas gates, and let you review before any change is applied.

bundles.name: Sovereign Pipeline
bundles.short: End-to-end training/data/eval loop. Local GPU only. 5-step workflow: census -> ingest -> sft (QLoRA) -> export (GGUF) -> register.
bundles.when_to_use: You want to fine-tune a local model on your own data. You need a recipe that goes from raw data to a verified, registered adapter on disk, with battery-gated promotion.

bundles.name: Sovereign Architect
bundles.short: Design/spec/plan lane. 5-step workflow: intake -> spec -> plan -> graph -> review. Pairs with sovereign-coder.
bundles.when_to_use: You have a vague intent and need a spec, a phased plan, an architecture graph, and a recommended next workflow bundle. Pairs with sovereign-coder: architect plans, coder builds.
